rule.rule: an event's SENG volume loss is used only if the 5th percentile of the epicentral distance from SENG to the reviewed IMO earthquakes in the first 24 h after onset is >= 3.0 km
rule.why: uses only the seismicity, not the GNSS losses or the published losses; written down on 2026-11-16 after the earlier (unblinded) selection of events 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11 had been seen
